name: VR Amazing Bathroom
summary:
There is a porcelain toilet in the middle of each world. Walk around it, sit down and see what is on the horizon. One seat looks out over the Li River at dawn. Another sits on a small orbital platform with Earth hanging beyond the deck. At the mountain lake, switch from sunset to a starry sky.
